capabilities: Generate a file-index.json listing all vault file paths
Maintain a map of basenames to file paths
Exclude files from the index via regex rules in file-index-ignore.json
extras: Warning in README: the plugin may have trouble distinguishing between files with the same basename in different folders.
motivation: The author wanted to support externally rendering Wikilinks with no knowledge of the vault file structure, for example in Glassflame.
problem: External tools that need to render wikilinks have no way to resolve basenames to vault file paths without knowing the vault structure.

relations.evidence: Useful to externally render Wikilinks with no knowledge of the file structure of the vault, for example in Glassflame.

summary: Plugin that creates and maintains a file-index.json at the vault root listing all file paths and a basename-to-path map.
